text: I kept only the 700 rows in euros, as you chose; the 800 rows in US dollars are left out because amounts in different currencies are never added together. Customer Spend needs the amount a customer spent in the 90 days after a snapshot date, and this file has no date column to count those days from, so I cannot build that outcome. I did not take amount as that spend: that would be a guess about what it means. The question asking you to add the missing column is still open, and training time is the other open question.
